VerifiedBearer.description: Credential validation, issuer, audience and scope configuration are pending deployment decisions. No token format is implied.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Single UUID correlation identifier. Echo the validated request value or generate one; it is not authorization or an idempotency key.
Single UUID correlation identifier. Echo the validated request value or generate one; it is not authorization or an idempotency key.

RetryAfter.description: Optional integer delay in seconds matching retry_after_seconds when present. Does not authorize retry.

WwwAuthenticate.description: Required authentication challenge on HTTP 401; configured by the authentication layer.

Error400.description: HTTP 400: malformed_json, unsupported_schema_version, invalid_request, invalid_cursor. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error401.description: HTTP 401: unauthenticated. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error403.description: HTTP 403: forbidden. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error404.description: HTTP 404: not_found. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error409.description: HTTP 409: idempotency_conflict, invalid_state_transition, approval_required, approval_expired, result_pending, remote_outcome_unknown, request_in_progress. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error413.description: HTTP 413: payload_too_large. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error415.description: HTTP 415: unsupported_media_type. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error422.description: HTTP 422: validation_failed, unsupported_capability, cancellation_unsupported, content_unavailable. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error429.description: HTTP 429: rate_limited. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error500.description: HTTP 500: internal_error. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error502.description: HTTP 502: auth_failed, remote_failure. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

Error503.description: HTTP 503: unavailable, remote_unavailable. HTTP mapping applies when this operation fails; a successful status lookup may contain a remote error without failing HTTP.

AgentCapabilities.title: AgentCapabilities
AgentCapabilities.description: Capabilities of the installed authorized adapter. Every support flag is explicit; no optimistic defaults. Operations reuse the multiplexer vocabulary.

AuthenticatedActor.title: AuthenticatedActor
AuthenticatedActor.description: Internal validator output; never a public request body or proof by itself. Construct after credential verification and registry lookup.

AuthorizationScope.title: AuthorizationScope
AuthorizationScope.description: Closed draft operation grants. A listed scope is necessary but never sufficient for ownership, approval or delegation.

CancellationReceipt.title: CancellationReceipt
CancellationReceipt.description: REQUESTED is an acknowledgement, not evidence of cancellation. Only CONFIRMED or a verified terminal observation can support a terminal transition.

Cursor.description: Opaque URL-safe authenticated pagination cursor. Syntax validation does not prove validity or authorization.

DelegationContext.title: DelegationContext
DelegationContext.description: Internal bounded dispatch grant issued from authorized persisted task state. Verify signature/introspection and actor/task binding before use; never trust a client-supplied copy.

DispatchAttempt.title: DispatchAttempt
DispatchAttempt.description: Persisted before network send. IDs and fingerprint identify one immutable logical dispatch; retransmission must not invent a new identity.

DispatchOutcome.title: DispatchOutcome
DispatchOutcome.description: Normalized authenticated multiplexer observation, not an HTTP status interpretation. Verify all bindings and supporting evidence before transitioning.

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: Closed draft v1 error vocabulary. HTTP mappings live in conventions/http.json; tests prevent drift. Codes do not authorize retries.

ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope
ErrorEnvelope.description: Draft normalized error. Message must be sanitized. Neither code nor retry_after_seconds grants permission to retry a side effect.

path.description: RFC 6901 pointer relative to the validated input; empty string denotes root. Do not echo untrusted property names; point to nearest declared ancestor.

IdempotencyRecord.title: IdempotencyRecord
IdempotencyRecord.description: Internal coordination metadata. RESERVED is not permission to execute after a crash. RETIRED prevents silent recreation after resource removal.

IdempotencyScope.title: IdempotencyScope
IdempotencyScope.description: Internal deduplication tuple. Tenant and principal are server-resolved; operation is server-selected. Never derive authority from this record.

IdentityMapping.title: IdentityMapping
IdentityMapping.description: Server-owned identity-link record. ACTIVE requires explicit verified linking; existence or schema validity does not authorize a caller.

ReconciliationOutcome.title: ReconciliationOutcome
ReconciliationOutcome.description: Dispatch lookup outcome. ABSENT requires current authoritative evidence of no prior acceptance and closure of in-flight acceptance. Missing/deleted jobs or eventually consistent empty searches are UNKNOWN, not absence proof.

RemoteResult.title: RemoteResult
RemoteResult.description: Terminal remote observation. A result is accepted only after owner, correlation, authorization and transition checks.

RequestFingerprint.title: RequestFingerprint
RequestFingerprint.description: Server-computed request comparison digest; not a credential, approval signature or remote retry guarantee.

TaskCallback.title: TaskCallback
TaskCallback.description: Authenticated remote observation envelope. Callback UUID is a deduplication key. Sequence is per remote job when available, otherwise null; timestamps alone do not prove ordering.
